geometry.renderer: V0, fixed camera-facing 5×5 per-pixel surfels, opacity .999

hidden.policy: Use GT recoverable surface points and input witness RGB. Cache only fixed parent samples. Recompute local disparity fit and footprint order every step under no_grad with detached current front depth, without passing labels to the network.
hidden.other_tiers: Visible only; C can retain its existing analytic LDR optical batches and K16 supervision.
hidden.evaluation_legacy: Archived GT recoverable parents and the same detached place().

frozen: All other rows of the geometry head (rear offset and normal), encoder, all feature blocks, learned prior selector, coverage and footprint modules. The input-derived total residual attenuation remains fixed.
weights_reason: Raise optical emphasis relative to Stage 1. The supervised geometry and same-surface weights share a 1/4000 multiplier; the old C dry run measured mean raw disp and bokeh gradient norms 13.20 and 0.0060. Keep larger relative occ/zero regularizers. Unchanged coverage is still logged.

optical.estimator: Independent stratified pupil-subset cross product, 8+8 rays. Clip each predicted ray before averaging.

data.hard_selection: Weight 2 for completed hard milestone scenes, weight 1 for other complete scenes. Suppress the foreground-focus priority for imported foregrounds below 1% as in 13.15.8.

training.optimizer: AdamW with weight decay 0 for row freezing
training.rationale: One-tenth of Stage 1 LR for a two-row geometry fine-tune; evaluate P2 f/1.4 on the benchmark's main masks.

evaluation.extra_scene_selection: Top and bottom two paired near-focus scene deltas; f030 near with evaluated fallback frame
evaluation.selection: Among EMA checkpoints satisfying all geometry and zero floors, maximize the new development near-focus pooled PSNR (earlier step wins ties). Adopt only if that checkpoint also has nonnegative paired near and far medians against step 0 with the same GT substitute and V0.

stage3a_v1_stop.reason: Two geometry readout rows lack spatial adaptation. Reducing B optics to 256 erases 1–3 pixel thin foreground features.

stage3a_v2.frozen: ViT encoder, coverage and footprint heads. Prior selector participates because its weights directly change fused front depth. All geometry rows are trainable. Rear depth keeps its existing geometry supervision; normal rows have no direct V0 or auxiliary loss in this configuration. Parameter deltas are recorded for each row.

optical.estimator: Independent stratified pupil-subset cross product, 8+8 rays. Clip each predicted ray before averaging.
optical.B_crop_sampling: One native crop. Alternate B draws: first draw and every second thereafter require at least one GT thin foreground pixel. Choose a random eligible configuration and uniform legal crop origin. Ordinary draws keep the full pool and the existing difficulty weights.
optical.B_thin_mask: Native first-hit object IDs for foreground_structure from the B generation label or thin-structure difficulty entry. Other foreground objects are excluded.
optical.B_screen_coordinates: Render all native V0 and detached GT geometry with only the principal point shifted; crop the native target and retain full-sensor F2 lookup.
optical.C: Retain the original resolution limit and optical sampling.

data.hard_selection: Weight 2 for completed hard milestone scenes, weight 1 for other complete scenes. Suppress the foreground-focus priority for imported foregrounds below 1% as in 13.15.8.

training.rationale: Keep the registered 3a learning rate and step count. Expand the existing depth decoder and use one native B crop in the per-process 14 GiB limit.
